tasks.subject: Task #3: Build dps.ts single-source DPS mapping
tasks.description:
**Goal:** One pure module owns the DPS table and every conversion, so speed/mode/brightness logic exists in exactly one place.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/dps.ts`, `test/dps.test.ts`
- Modify: `CHANGELOG.md`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] DPS table declared once; no conversion arithmetic anywhere else
- [ ] Speed conversion covers steps 0-5 to 0-100%, clamping out-of-range input
- [ ] Mode matched case-insensitively; written back Capitalised (device reports "Normal")
- [ ] UNRECOGNISED modes PRESERVED, not discarded (strict reject would drop "Normal", the live value on all 8 fans)
- [ ] An ABSENT speed DP yields undefined, never 0 (2 of 8 fans omit DP 3)
- [ ] `brightnessScale` is an explicit parameter, not a hardcoded constant
- [ ] Module imports nothing from `homebridge` or `tuyapi`
- [ ] CHANGELOG entry added

**Verify:** `npx vitest run test/dps.test.ts` passes.


tasks.subject: Task #6: UDP discovery module
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Resolve device IP and protocol version at runtime so users supply only id, key and name.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/tuya/discovery.ts`, `test/discovery.test.ts`
- Modify: `CHANGELOG.md`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Listens on UDP 6666 and 6667, decodes plaintext and AES-ECB payloads
- [ ] Returns { id, ip, version } per device, deduplicated
- [ ] Resolves after a caller-supplied timeout and closes every socket
- [ ] A bind failure on one port does not prevent the other working
- [ ] Malformed/short frames return null rather than throwing
- [ ] Importable by both platform.ts and the UI server
- [ ] CHANGELOG entry added

**Verify:** `npx vitest run test/discovery.test.ts` passes; live run from inside the Homebridge container finds all 8 known device IDs.

Note: AES-ECB is mandated by Tuya's wire protocol with a published constant key. Decode-only, protects nothing. Do not "fix" it to GCM.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/tuya/discovery.ts", "test/discovery.test.ts", "CHANGELOG.md"], "verifyCommand": "npx vitest run test/discovery.test.ts", "acceptanceCriteria": ["decodes plaintext and AES-ECB frames", "returns null for rubbish instead of throwing", "closes all sockets on timeout", "bind failure on one port survivable", "live run finds all 8 device IDs"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```
